segments.text: So what is your out take on the campus girls?
I do believe that they have a right to exist here just as much as we do.
And whatever they do, they trouble us sometimes in the hostel.
In HBU we see them a lot.
I think the main issues raised in HB are that they drink water from a cooler.
The logic is pretty clear, if they have to drink water from a cooler, it means their spots are not given on campus.
Like in our CCF, there's supposed to be water bowls around the campus where birds and dogs can drink water.
In fact, there is a feeder around the campus that feeds them.
So if they go to trash cans and...
...you know, where it's scrounging out something
then that means they don't get food outside
And this should be put in the campus committee.
So does CCF raise these issues?
I mean honestly, as a community, CCF should make other people aware
because I think feeding anywhere or students not being aware of what actions we should take
creates a lot of issue.
But we are actively conducting surveys inside the campus that people know about CCF and almost 80% of the people seem to not even know about the existence of CCF.
So what is CCF doing for them?
Okay, good point! I think CCF should definitely hold more sensitization programs
But even if it did, what is the guarantee that people would agree?
Because I see with as the years go by
People are growing more intolerant towards the biodiversity that's around
But actually these are some things which need to be set up by community rules
That as a community everybody is following certain rules
Then one or two people overthrow those rules
Then strict actions can be taken against them
But being totally unaware of any such campus committee makes it quite unaccountable on the campus point of view.
I mean, if CCF exists for this particular reason then and people don't even know about their existence
so that's kind of...I don't think that is quite genuine from CCFs point of view
That's definitely a good point
And we have been discussing it in fact
I think we had our intro talk today
and it was spontaneous
All those things should be taken into account when working on a campus
Does CCF work with the security committee and the hospitals when vaccination drives are being conducted?
Yearly, I think even biannually there are vaccination drives where new dogs and puppies are neutered or paid.
They get proper vaccines and you will notice that most of the dogs are within the campus.
The ones that are friendly around SBK and even around HBK they're not aggressive.
They just hound you because they are looking for food.
But the vaccinated dogs especially will see that their ears are a little ticked off.
So all of that and yeah I think...
And whose jurisdiction is it to feed these dogs and make this feeding station very functional?
Is it the CCF or is it the community or the authorities, campus authorities?
Campus authorities.
So does CCF go and contact them and are you guys actively working for them?
I am not at that level of administrator but there are supposed to be people going around, feeders that are appointed for this.
There is supposed to be paravets that look after the dogs and regarding vaccination of dogs it's always regular.
What was your experience like?
I mean, my family has been a dog since childhood so I was very lovable with them.
And here also I don't think there are any major issues like that.
But many people have a lot of problems, many people have phobias from dogs
What does CCF do for that?
What is done for the dogs but what to do about those people?
Good point!
Like I said, it is an ongoing discussion. In fact this point has been raised that there should be sensitization programs.
And yes obviously there should be sensitization programs but if you go out of campus and when you will be living on your own or you will roam the streets
then you think you won't encounter animals where there are dogs, cats, cows etc.
So, there should be some general humanity in this sense that
This is just a general survival instinct
If an animal comes towards me then I will run away
I think of something in the moment
